newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Strong U.S. gains lift Swedish shares higher.
newsitem.headline: Strong U.S. gains lift Swedish shares higher.

text.p: 1100 GMT - Swedish shares ended higher on Wednesday, lifted by New York's strong gains a day earlier.
* Stockholm general index up 0.69 percent to 2,640.92
* Drugs and forestry shares belonged to the winners
* Drugs major Astra jumped six crowns to 321 and rival Pharmacia & Upjohn leaped seven to 226, both riding on their gains in the U.S. on Tuesday
* Household appliance maker Electrolux kept falling after releasing first quarter earnings a day earlier, down eight crowns to 450
Swedish shares ended higher in the half day of trading on Wednesday, lifted by New York's strong gains a day earlier.
The market closed at 1100 GMT ahead of the Labour Day holiday on Thursday.
The bourse's general index rose 0.69 percent to 2,640.92 in turnover of 2.85 billion crowns. "...there is probably room for further advances," a trader said.
Drugs major Astra jumped six crowns to 321 and rival Pharmacia & Upjohn leaped seven to 226, both were riding on their gains in the U.S. on Tuesday.
The forestry sector also belonged to winners, up 2.39 percent on hopes that sluggish market trends will pick up.
Telecoms group Ericsson kept recovering from its Monday slide, up two to 248 crowns.
But household appliance maker Electrolux continued to fall after releasing first quarter earnings a day earlier. The share fell eight crowns to 450 after plummeting 15 on Tuesday.
The bank sector also had a bad day and slipped 0.28 percent, partly because some of the shares were trading ex-dividend. -- Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700 1017
